title: Make login entry point visible and ensure admin moderation is reachable after login

requirements.text:
Add a clearly visible authentication entry point across the app so users can always find where to log in.

- Update the global header (AppHeader) to show:
  - A "Login" button/link when the user is not authenticated that navigates to /login.
  - A "Logout" action when the user is authenticated.
  - Keep existing navigation (Home, Articles, About, Contact) intact.
- Add a prominent "Login" call-to-action on the Home page hero section for unauthenticated users that navigates to /login (in addition to existing Read/Share buttons).
acceptanceCriteria: When browsing any page while logged out, the header contains a visible "Login" control that navigates to /login.
When logged in, the header no longer shows "Login" and instead provides a visible "Logout" control.
On the Home page while logged out, a prominent "Login" button is visible in the hero section and navigates to /login.
All user-facing text added/changed is in English.

requirements.text:
Ensure the admin approval workflow is accessible once the user is authenticated and is an admin.

- Keep the existing admin-only visibility rule for the Admin link, but verify that:
  - The Admin link appears in the header when the authenticated user is an admin.
  - The /admin route continues to render the existing AdminModerationPage and shows the "Awaiting Approval" tab with pending submissions for admins.
  - Non-admins (or logged-out users) continue to see an access denied state on /admin with a login prompt when logged out.
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with an admin identity, the header shows an "Admin" navigation option and it navigates to /admin.
On /admin as an admin, the Admin Moderation page loads and includes the "Awaiting Approval" area for reviewing/publishing submissions.
On /admin as a logged-out user, an access denied view is shown with a visible Internet Identity login prompt.
On /admin as a non-admin logged-in user, an access denied view is shown indicating lack of admin privileges.

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain single-actor (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo); only add a migration if persistent state schema changes (not expected for this request).
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
Changing admin permission rules or adding new admin management UI in the backend.
